_doc: Role -> ordered lanes for the free swarm kitchen (Plan B). Each lane is (provider, model). Every role ends in the local Ollama floor so it can never run out of capacity. privacy=sensitive roles are restricted to no-train lanes (groq/cerebras/nvidia) or local; privacy=public_ok roles may use training-on-input lanes (gemini/mistral) because they only see public scraped pages. Provider API keys live in gitignored per-provider key files, NEVER here. Spec: markdown/planning/FREE-AGENT-PLAN-B-KITCHEN.md sec 7.

groq._note: NOT $0 in practice -- this account is on Groq's paid on-demand tier (confirmed 2026-07-06: 1,598 calls / ~19M tokens over 12 days with zero 429s, versus a Free-plan cap of 100K tok/day on llama-3.3-70b-versatile -- Free would have hard-blocked >90% of that volume). Real per-token billing at console.groq.com rates. Kept ONLY on the cheap, low-volume 'coordinator' role (~$0.17 total over the same 12 days); removed from 'chef'/'coder' where prompt size made it the dominant cost driver (~$9.30 of an estimated ~$9.50 total). spend_summary.py now prices real Groq usage from swarm-calls.jsonl instead of assuming $0.
